scenes.headline: How a trillion-parameter model runs 49B per token
scenes.sub: Mistral Large 4, before its weights ship.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Chonk! Mistral Large 4 stores about a trillion parameters, and runs forty-nine billion per token.

scenes.text: Keep most of the model as experts on the shelf, and wake only the few each token needs.
scenes.say: Most of the model sits on the shelf as experts, and each token wakes only the few it needs.

scenes.title: One block, as Large 3 built it

steps.say: Large 4's files are not out, so start with its parent, Large 3. Each block opens with latent attention and a small compressed cache.
A router sends each token to four experts. The rest stay idle.
One shared expert always runs. Large 4 goes sparser, with more experts on the shelf.

steps.label: dense
steps.say: In a dense model, every token uses every weight.

steps.label: sparse
steps.say: In a sparse one, each token lights a few experts, a different few each time.

scenes.title: Where Large 3's parameters live
scenes.say: Count Large 3's config, and almost all its weight is routed experts. Attention is a rounding error beside it.

steps.say: Then reinforcement learning. A fleet of actors attempts tasks from many environments.
They write about thirty-three billion tokens of attempts a day.
Filtering keeps about sixteen billion as training signal.
The trainer updates while the actors keep going, and this run is still climbing.

scenes.title: Doing the task, or refusing it

steps.say: The distinctive result is security. On this cyber index, Large 4 completes the most tasks.
Other models lose much of their score to safety blocks, hanging from the top.

scenes.label: Artificial Analysis index, best open model from the US or Europe
scenes.note: eighth among all open models listed
scenes.say: On the aggregate index, it is the best open model from the US or Europe, and eighth overall.

scenes.text: The trillion is storage. The forty-nine billion is the work, and price and speed follow the work.
scenes.say: So the trillion is storage, and the forty-nine billion is the work. Price and speed follow the work.

recap: A router wakes a few experts per token
Weights promised by end of October
scenes.say: A router wakes a few experts, training keeps running, and weights are due by the end of October.
